channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues da PF e a guerra deflagrada no STF - O Assunto #1800
item.description: Minister André Mendonça temporarily removed Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, and delegate Leandro Almada amid an escalating institutional crisis following opposition demonstrations during the Independence Day holiday. The decision was upheld by the STF's Second Division and sparked mixed reactions, including support from 11 PF directors and legal action by the AGU to challenge the measure. The episode highlights growing tensions between the Supreme Court, the Federal Police, and the federal government.

item.title: Los beneficiarios de la ‘ley de nietos’, ante la suspensión del derecho a votar: “Es distinguir entre ciudadanos de una categoría y otra”
item.description: The Supreme Court of Spain decided to suspend the voting rights of citizens who obtained nationality through the grandchildren's law, a measure questioned by beneficiaries in Latin America. The decision partially upheld a petition from the far-right party Vox, which claims the socialist government is trying to inflate the electoral census. The suspension affects descendants of Spanish exiles who returned to European citizenship.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio pede cassação da chapa Lula-Alckmin por suposto abuso de poder em desfile na Sapucaí
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the annulment of the Lula-Alckmin ticket over alleged abuse of power during the 2026 Carnival parade by the Acadêmicos de Niterói, which honored Lula. The complaint cites R$9.65 million in public funds and R$2.5 million in private donations attributed to the first lady, currently under review by the TCU. Lula’s defense has not yet publicly responded to the action.

item.title: Virada numérica em MG acende alerta para Lula; leia análise de Felipe Nunes
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in Minas Gerais by 40% to 37% in the second round, reversing the previous advantage. This numerical shift is interpreted as a warning for Lula's campaign, given Minas Gerais' historical trend of anticipating presidential winners. Despite the closeness, the poll is seen as a snapshot, not a forecast.

item.title: Lula silencia sobre afastamento de Andrei; presidente cumpre agenda no Piauí nesta quarta
item.description: President Lula did not publicly comment on the decision by Minister André Mendonça to order the preventive removal of Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues. The AGU attempted to overturn the ruling at the STF, citing infringement on presidential appointment powers. Lula continued his scheduled activities in Piauí, avoiding direct remarks on the matter.

item.title: Presidenciáveis já gastaram R$ 74 milhões nas campanhas com publicidade, estratégia digital, voos e advogados
item.description: The main 2026 presidential candidates have already declared R$ 74 million in campaign spending, led by Flávio Bolsonaro (R$ 49.5 million) and Ronaldo Caiado (R$ 20 million). Expenses include advertising, digital strategy, flights, and legal services. The deadline for partial accounting submission to the Electoral Justice began on September 9th.

item.title: Quaest: veja como está a corrida presidencial em SP, RJ, MG, PE e DF
item.description: Quaest polls show Lula at 36% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 29% in the first round of the presidential race, leading in SP, RJ, MG, PE and DF. In the Federal District, Flávio leads with 31%, followed by Lula at 28%. Caiado, Cury, Zema and Renan round out the scenario with smaller mentions.

item.title: Fenapef após afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues: "Acima de disputas políticas"
item.description: The Fenapef stated that the Federal Police must remain above political disputes following the 90-day preventive leave of Andrei Rodrigues, ordered by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The entity called for impartial, transparent investigations respecting due process and avoiding any politicization. It emphasized its independent and nonpartisan stance, reaffirming the PF’s commitment to society and the democratic rule of law.

item.title: Empresários pedem em manifesto afastamento de investigados do Master
item.description: A group of 157 prominent figures, including economists and business leaders, signed a manifesto requesting the precautionary removal of officials under formal investigation in the Master case, emphasizing the need for impartial investigations and adherence to the rule of law. The document criticizes the Brazilian political and judicial system for failing to apply equal scrutiny across all societal sectors.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: nova pesquisa Quaest mede a eleição presidencial
item.description: The Quaest poll for 2026 measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, investigating voting intentions, candidate awareness, and rejection rates, as well as the impact of the Banco Master case on political perception. The survey includes five runoff scenarios and addresses exposure to electoral advertising.

item.title: Nova pesquisa testa disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: A new poll by Real Time Big Data simulates a runoff between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) among São Paulo voters, featuring 13 first-round candidates and measuring candidate rejection and approval of Lula's government. The survey will be released on September 14 after interviewing 2,000 voters.

item.title: Zema sai em defesa de Mendonça e diz não ver excesso em atuação do ministro
item.description: Zema defends Mendonça and criticizes Moraes, stating that the investigation into the Banco Master case is being conducted properly. He also claims that some STF ministers are a shame for the country and calls for a 'clean-up' of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Fachin diz que Justiça não faltará à “legalidade constitucional”
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin stated that the Judiciary will remain bound by the Constitution amid a crisis involving a dispute between ministers Moraes and Mendonça over Master Bank investigations. Fachin emphasized that Brazilian justice is capable of meeting current challenges and will uphold constitutional legality. The CNJ, also led by Fachin, serves as an institutional mediator during this crisis.

item.title: OAB-DF abre processo ético-disciplinar contra escritório de mulher de Moraes
item.description: The OAB-DF (Brazilian Bar Association in the Federal District) opened an ethical-disciplinary proceeding against the lawyers of the Barci de Moraes law firm, linked to the family of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The action investigates possible professional misconduct in the practice of law. The case has drawn attention from the press and the national legal community.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio nos três maiores colégios eleitorais do país
item.description: Quaest polls show Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula in runoff simulations across Brazil's three largest electoral colleges, with clear leads in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, while Minas Gerais shows a technical tie.

item.title: PT defende reforma do Judiciário: “O povo quer saber a verdade”
item.description: PT leader Edinho Silva calls for Judiciary reform and investigations into the STF, criticizing the PL over alleged deals involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Banco Master, while reaffirming support for Lula and democratic institutions.

item.title: "Golpe à democracia", diz Caiado após cancelamento de debate presidencial
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for their absence from the presidential debate, calling the cancellation an attack on Brazilian democracy. He highlighted the Vorcaro scandal allegations and questioned their opponents' ability to govern.

item.title: Haddad: Impeachment no STF é medida extrema, depende de amparo nos fatos e não paixão política
item.description: Haddad says impeaching STF ministers is an extreme measure requiring facts, not political passion. He calls for transparency in the Banco Master investigations and avoids taking sides on involved officials. He criticizes using institutions for political purposes.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que crise no STF ‘é inegável’ e defende apuração de ‘todas as denúncias’
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva acknowledged the crisis at the STF as undeniable and called for swift, transparent investigations into all allegations, aiming to distance Lula's campaign from the backlash against minister Moraes. He also criticized PL figures, such as Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro, over alleged corruption and anti-democratic actions.

item.title: Fachin dá 72 horas para Mendonça se manifestar sobre recurso da AGU contra afastamento de Andrei
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin granted 72 hours for Justice Minister André Mendonça to respond to the Attorney General's appeal seeking to suspend the provisional suspension of Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues. The AGU argues that the suspension violates the constitutional prerogative of the President of the Republic.

item.title: OAB abre processo disciplinar no DF contra escritório da esposa de Alexandre de Moraes em Brasília
item.description: The OAB-DF has initiated an ethical-disciplinary process against the Barci e Barci law firm, linked to the family of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, based on Federal Police investigations involving the former owner of Banco Master. The investigation suggests alleged irregularities in contracts and political influence, with possible penalties including fines and suspension. The case also involves lawyer Ciro Soares, accused of mediating communications between businessmen and authorities.

item.title: Veja como foi a terça-feira (8) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Tuesday (8), presidential candidates held institutional and campaign activities. Lula and Flávio had no recorded public appearances, while Caiado emphasized spending cuts and tech investments. Zema and Renan made media appearances, and Caiador visited research centers.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido de Tarcísio contra vídeo de Haddad que liga campanha a doação de Vorcaro
item.description: The Electoral Court rejected Tarcísio de Freitas's request against a video by Fernando Haddad linking campaign to a donation from Vorcaro. The decision was made on Monday (8) after reviewing content aired during free broadcast time. The case involves electoral criticism and resource usage in the race.

item.title: RedeTV! News (08/09/26) | Completo
item.description: The RedeTV! News program dated 09/08/2026 provides a summary of the main news from Brazil and abroad, covering topics such as economy, security, health, education, and foreign policy. Among the highlights, the new directory of Hospital de Amor was inaugurated, expanding medical care in the country. The content is structured as a full newscast, with national and international coverage, without name-dropping political candidates during the analytical segment.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos ao Senado por São Paulo (SP) nas eleições 2026
item.description: Fifteen politicians are competing for the two Senate seats in São Paulo in the 2026 elections, with Simone Tebet, Guilherme Derrite, and Marina Silva leading the polls. The seats are vacated by Giordano and Mara Gabrilli, who are not seeking re-election, while astronaut Marcos Pontes completes the trio until 2031. André do Prado and Dr. Eliana Ferreira are notable candidates with distinct political tracks in state and federal politics.

item.title: Associação de delegados da PF critica afastamento de Andrei e cobra julgamento pelo plenário do STF
item.description: The National Association of Federal Police Delegates condemned the provisional removal of director-general Andrei Rodrigues, decided unilaterally by Minister André Mendonça, and demanded the case be submitted to the STF plenary. The association labeled the situation as a serious institutional crisis and stressed the need to respect constitutional procedures. Meanwhile, the Federal Attorney General's Office challenges the injunction, claiming it violates the president's constitutional prerogative.

item.title: Lula podia ter exonerado Andrei Rodrigues e não o fez
item.description: Carlos Graieb and Duda Teixeira analyze Lula's decision not to dismiss Andrei Rodrigues despite having the authority to do so. They question the closeness between Federal Police delegates and Supreme Court justices in producing intelligence reports used as a political tool within the Court.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE para cassar chapa de Lula por desfile de carnaval
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a lawsuit at the TSE to annul the Lula and Alckmin ticket, alleging irregular use of public funds in the Niterói samba parade that honored Lula during Carnival. The suit claims over R$9.65 million in public money was used and government infrastructure was leveraged for electoral purposes. The case is under review by Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira and is being processed alongside another action filed by the Partido Novo.

item.title: O recado das pesquisas para Lula na reta final da campanha, segundo CEO da Nexus
item.description: BTG/Nexus survey shows reversal in second-round race: Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) ahead of Lula (45%), within margin of error. Lula still leads first round at 39%, but Flávio rose to 35%, tightening the race in a close election.

item.title: Por que candidato com 9% no primeiro turno aparece à frente de Lula no segundo turno em pesquisa
item.description: A candidate with 9% in the first round leads Lula in the second round due to high rejection rates of the president and Cury's appeal as an alternative in binary races. The BTG/Nexus poll shows a technical tie between Cury and Lula in the second round, but experts note this may not reflect real strength to reach the final. The scenario is deemed unlikely for Cury against Lula or Flávio in the second round.

item.title: Crise no STF acende sinal vermelho na campanha de Lula e Planalto pede rápida intervenção de Fachin
item.description: The unprecedented crisis at the STF, driven by the clash between ministers Moraes and Mendonça, worries Lula's campaign, which pressures Fachin to calm the situation. The instability may impact the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Fora de controle, a crise no STF contamina a disputa eleitoral
item.description: The internal crisis at the STF, marked by conflicts between ministers such as Alexandre de Morais and André Mendonça, has contaminated the 2026 electoral dispute, causing institutional wear and risks for exception control. Lawmakers and institutions such as the PF and the PGR entered the race, with political campaigns trying to exploit the impasse. The wave of institutional distrust amplified the climate of polarization before the polls.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba o que pode e o que não pode na rua
item.description: The 2026 street campaign in Brazil must follow TSE regulations, allowing rallies from 8am to midnight, sound trucks, and graphic material distribution until 10pm the day before elections. Shows, gifts, billboards, and public property advertising are prohibited, with fines for violations.

item.title: Conselheiros de Lula e Flávio para a Saúde apresentam planos semelhantes para o SUS
item.description: The health advisors chosen by Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro presented similar proposals for SUS during an event on Tuesday. Both advisory approaches defend strengthening the public health system, although with distinct approaches.

item.title: Robô humanoide que bateu continência a Lula custa R$ 194 mil
item.description: A humanoid robot from Chinese company Unitree Robotics, model G1 (EDU version), was showcased during the September 7th parade and interacted with President Lula and First Lady Janja. The equipment, acquired by the Military Institute of Engineering with funding from the Ministry of Science, costs R$194,000 and is used for AI and robotics algorithm development.

item.title: Pedido do Novo embasou decisão de Mendonça contra Andrei Rodrigues
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues based on a petition filed by the Novo Party in the Banco Master investigation. Presidential candidate Romeu Zema celebrated the decision, emphasizing the party's stance against corruption. The Federal Police released a statement supporting Andrei, deeming the attacks unfounded.

item.title: Saída de Mendonça da relatoria do Caso Master amenizaria o clima no STF, diz Kakay
item.description: Lawyer Kakay states that removing André Mendonça from the Case Master rapporteurship could ease the institutional crisis at the STF, but argues this should result from institutional dialogue, similar to the process that removed Dias Toffoli. Mendonça unilaterally ordered the dismissal of the Federal Police leadership after Moraes requested an investigation into him for alleged abuse of authority in the Master Bank investigation. The decision sparked reactions within the Supreme Court, with divisions among justices regarding the second chamber's jurisdiction to judge the case.

item.title: AGU pede que Fachin restitua Andrei Rodrigues para a chefia da PF
item.description: The AGU requested the STF to suspend Andrei Rodrigues' removal from the PF leadership, arguing that Minister André Mendonça's decision violates presidential authority and risks institutional disruption. The Lula administration prepares an appeal and considers official statements, while Fachin reviews the case after receiving an intelligence report.

item.title: Nova lei cria fundo para promover acesso à Justiça gratuita
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.500/26, creating the Access to Justice Support Fund to strengthen free legal defense by the Federal Public Defender's Office for needy individuals. The law establishes management councils and funding sources, but the government partially vetoed it for budgetary and unconstitutionality concerns, removing provisions on donations and fines.

item.title: Augusto Cury recebe apoio de Paulinho da Força, presidente do Solidariedade
item.description: Paulinho da Força, president of Solidariedade, endorsed Augusto Cury (Avante), distancing from the polarization between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. Cury leads polls in a hypothetical runoff with 45% versus Lula's 43%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ultrapassa Lula no 2º turno em estado-chave das eleições, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 8 shows Flávio Bolsonaro surpassing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the second round in Minas Gerais, with 40% against 37%, within the margin of error. The poll, commissioned by Globo, reveals a trend of growth for Flávio since August 2025 and stabilization in Minas Gerais voting intentions.

item.title: Lula deve defender saída institucional para crise e evitar ataques a Mendonça
item.description: Following a meeting with allies and ministers, President Lula is expected to advocate for institutional solutions to the crisis between the STF and PF, avoiding attacks against Mendonça and addressing the conflict as a crisis of institutionalism.

item.title: Marília, Humberto e Mendonça lideram disputa pelo Senado no PE, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey released in September 2026 shows that Marília Arraes (PDT), Humberto Costa (PT), and Mendonça Filho (PL) lead the Senate race in Pernambuco with 17%, 14%, and 11% of voter intention, respectively. Conducted between September 4 and 7, 2026, the survey interviewed 1,302 voters with a margin of error of 3 percentage points, and is registered at the TSE under number PE-00285/2026.

item.title: AGU vai a Fachin para suspender a liminar que afastou Andrei Rodrigues da PF
item.description: The AGU requested the STF to suspend the injunction that removed Andrei Rodrigues from the Federal Police, arguing that the decision violates the constitutional prerogative of President Lula. The case arises amid a conflict between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, rapporteur of investigations at the Federal Police. The crisis involves allegations of abuse of authority and judicial inquiries.

item.title: Quaest: A disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em SP, MG, RJ, DF e PE
item.description: Quaest polls update the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in SP, MG, RJ, DF, and PE with data on voting intentions for presidential, senate, and state races. In São Paulo, Flávio leads with 31% against Lula's 30%. In Minas Gerais, Lula leads with 31% versus Flávio's 27%. The surveys have a margin of error of two to three percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a governador de São Paulo (SP) nas eleições 2026
item.description: Seven candidates run for São Paulo governor in 2026, with Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) as the frontrunner and Fernando Haddad (PT) as the main opponent. The election takes place on October 4, with a runoff on October 25 if needed.

item.title: AGU recorre a Edson Fachin para suspender afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues da PF
item.description: The AGU appealed to the STF to suspend the removal of Andrei Rodrigues from the PF, citing damage to public order and violation of presidential prerogative. The request seeks an injunction to immediately halt the decision by Minister André Mendonça, while the STF's Second Chamber reviews the case following a request for review by Justice Gilmar Mendes.

item.title: Lula não deve responder a ofício que pede afastamento de Paulo Gonet
item.description: President Lula should not dismiss Attorney General Paulo Gonet, avoiding prejudgment despite opposition pressure. The case involves conversations between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Gonet, under investigation at the Supreme Court. Lula already ignored the ANPR list when appointing Gonet in 2023, replicating Bolsonaro's practice with Augusto Aras.

item.title: TSE admite ação do PT contra Flávio por ato em Barretos
item.description: The TSE accepted the PT's lawsuit against Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged abuse of economic power during an event in Barretos. The action questions the senator's participation on stage at the Peão de Barretos festival, arguing it violates campaign regulations. The case was forwarded for judicial analysis.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 31% no Distrito Federal; Lula, 28%
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 8, 2026, shows that senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads the race for the Presidential Palace in the Federal District with 31%, against 28% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the first round. In a hypothetical runoff, Flávio would have 45% of the votes in the DF, surpassing Lula with 38%. The survey interviewed 1,144 voters between September 4 and 7, with a margin of error of three percentage points and a 95% confidence level.
